headline: Nuclear Startups Achieve Criticality Milestone, Sparking 'Nuclear Renaissance' Debate
reasoning: This topic is highly relevant to tech, involving startups, advanced reactor designs, and their potential to power data centers. The achievement of criticality by multiple companies represents a significant, newsworthy milestone, even if commercialization is still distant. It offers substantial reader value by exploring a potential future energy source and the interplay between innovation, regulation, and investment.
summary: Three nuclear startups have reached criticality with new reactor designs as part of a Department of Energy pilot program, aiming to accelerate the development of next-generation atomic energy, though experts caution about the long road to commercial viability.

source_articles.title: 3 Nuclear Startups Hit a Big Milestone. Why It Matters—and Why It Doesn’t
source_articles.excerpt: The companies’ Fourth of July plans include celebrating new reactor designs coming online. But there’s still a long way to go before they deliver energy at a meaningful scale.
